sourceMethod: Original AI-authored 1536×1024 3×2 contact sheet (six 512×512 poses) with a pale baked backdrop; each cell was isolated using the image's alpha confidence, preserved as 512px source, arranged into 3072×512 transparent 6×1 source WebP, then downsampled to 324px WebP frames. No enlargement of the legacy 96px atlas.
limitations: New armored silhouette is bulkier than the currently used Crystal Sentinel; character identity is not approved.
Source was computer-matted from an image with pale background; inspect halos and residual background in the target scene.
Requires real gameplay animation, six-pose timing/direction and human visual sign-off before release.
Not an automatically activated production asset.
